download_file_with_progress: download a file from a URL to a local path with a tqdm progress bar
compute_md5_hash: compute the MD5 hash of a file given its file path
get_checkpoint_path: get or download a model checkpoint by name to a root directory with optional MD5 verification
retrieve_nested_value: retrieve a value from a nested dict or list using a slash-separated key path string
handle_key_not_found: raise a KeyNotFoundError exception with cause, keys, and visited path context
